narr: Strong thunderstorms developed over the area as monsoon moisture combined with an upper level low off the southern California coast.
ev: A USGS stream gauge reported a rise of 5.01 feet on the Agua Fria River near Humboldt.

Public reported a low water crossing at N. Contessa Way flooded and impassible with several feet of flowing water. Radar estimated 1.25-1.75 inches occurred in 30 minutes over the Dry Beaver Creek Basin just north of McGuireville.
